full_name: Servicio de Impuestos Internos (SII) -- Estadisticas de Empresas por Region y Comuna

features.definition: Real count of dependent (payroll) jobs reported by employers whose tax domicile is registered in the comuna -- jobs located in the comuna (jobs-by-workplace), not employed residents. Chile's equivalent of USA LODES WAC jobsTotal. Most recent year published in SII's PUB_Reg_Com.xlsx comunal series is commercial year 2015 -- see pycensus.countries.chile.sii.api module docstring for the vintage caveat.
